newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK FINMIN SETS 4-WEEK T-BILL AUCTION FOR WED.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK FINMIN SETS 4-WEEK T-BILL AUCTION FOR WED.

text.p: The Slovak Finance Ministry will auction an unspecified tranche of four-week treasury bills on Wednesday, the National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said on Monday.
The ministry did not announce a maximum or expected yield.
In it's last successful auction of four-week T-bills on February 26, average yield hit 14.66 percent after 13.957 percent in a similar auction on February 12.
One month funds on the Slovak interbank money market were trading at around 16.75 percent on Monday.
